whoami.name: whoami
whoami.description: Answer questions to find out which character from Greek mythology you are.

zeus.name: Zeus
zeus.description: **Zeus** is the king of the gods, ruler of Olympus, and master of the sky. He has a dominant, impulsive, and charismatic personality, always ready to enforce his authority. ⚡️

poseidon.name: Poseidon
poseidon.description: **Poseidon** is the god of the oceans, creator of storms and earthquakes. He has an impetuous, passionate, and vengeful personality, driven by raw emotions. 🌊

hera.name: Hera
hera.description: **Hera** is the queen of the gods and protector of the home and marriage. She has a proud, strategic, and unyielding personality when it comes to defending her status and principles. 👑

hades.name: Hades
hades.description: **Hades** is the master of the underworld and buried riches. He has a solitary, highly logical, and stoic personality, preferring the shadows to the light. 💀

athena.name: Athena
athena.description: **Athena** is the goddess of wisdom and military strategy. She has a thoughtful, methodical, and calm personality, constantly seeking the most just and rational solution. 🦉

apollo.name: Apollo
apollo.description: **Apollo** is the god of light, music, and the arts. He has a radiant, creative, and perfectionist personality, driven by the pursuit of harmony and excellence. 🎵

artemis.name: Artemis
artemis.description: **Artemis** is the goddess of the hunt, the wilderness, and the moon. She has a fiercely independent personality, protective of her own, and detached from artificiality. 🏹

ares.name: Ares
ares.description: **Ares** is the god of brutal war and the chaos of battle. He has an explosive, reckless, and headstrong personality, never backing down from a conflict. ⚔️

aphrodite.name: Aphrodite
aphrodite.description: **Aphrodite** is the goddess of beauty, seduction, and love. She has a captivating, expressive, and at times fickle personality, fully aware of her power of attraction. ❤️

hephaestus.name: Hephaestus
hephaestus.description: **Hephaestus** is the god of fire, craftsmen, and the Olympus forges. He has a persevering, ingenious, and reserved personality, expressing himself through his creations. 🔥

hermes.name: Hermes
hermes.description: **Hermes** is the messenger of the gods and protector of travelers and tricksters. He has a sharp, mischievous, and highly adaptable personality, capable of wiggling out of any situation. 🕊️

dionysus.name: Dionysus
dionysus.description: **Dionysus** is the god of wine, theater, and letting go. He has an epicurean, festive, and unconventional personality, bringing energy and wildness wherever he goes. 🍷

demeter.name: Demeter
demeter.description: **Demeter** is the goddess of the earth, nature, and harvests. She has a deeply empathetic, benevolent, and protective personality, willing to do anything for her loved ones. 🌾

hercules.name: Hercules
hercules.description: **Hercules** is a demigod of superhuman strength, famous for his Twelve Labors. He has a courageous, impulsive personality, always ready to protect those he cares about. 🦁

achilles.name: Achilles
achilles.description: **Achilles** is the greatest warrior of the Trojan War, invulnerable except for his heel. He has a proud, passionate, and highly intense personality. 🗡️

odysseus.name: Odysseus
odysseus.description: **Odysseus** is the king of Ithaca renowned for his cunning, strategic mind, and long journey in the Odyssey. He has an extremely resourceful and persistent personality. ⛵

perseus.name: Perseus
perseus.description: **Perseus** is the slayer of the Gorgon Medusa and savior of Andromeda. He has a resourceful, thoughtful personality guided by a strong sense of justice. 🛡️

medusa.name: Medusa
medusa.description: **Medusa** is a Gorgon with a petrifying gaze and living snakes for hair. She has a distrustful, deeply solitary, and defensive personality, shaped by her tragic past. 🐍

minotaur.name: The Minotaur
minotaur.description: **The Minotaur** is a half-man, half-bull monster trapped at the center of the Labyrinth. He has a brutal, impulsive personality driven by fierce and untamed instincts. 🐂

cerberus.name: Cerberus
cerberus.description: **Cerberus** is the three-headed hound guarding the Underworld. He has a fiercely loyal, incorruptible, and overprotective personality regarding his domain and master. 🐕

sphinx.name: The Sphinx
sphinx.description: **The Sphinx** is a winged creature with a lion's body who devours those unable to answer her riddles. She has a mysterious, highly intellectual, and playful personality. 🦁

sirens.name: The Sirens
sirens.description: **The Sirens** are creatures with enchanting voices that lure sailors to their doom against the rocks. They have a seductive, manipulative, and mischievous personality, using charm to get what they want. 🧜‍♀️

fields.result_footer: Quick disclaimer: this test is purely fictional and does not reflect reality. It is intended for entertainment purposes only (mostly because I get bored in lectures).

questions.conflict: Faced with an open argument, what is your first reflex?
questions.ideal-space: What is your ideal workspace or living area?
questions.ambiguous-task: You are given an important mission with very few instructions. What do you do?

questions.unexpected-obstacle: What is your strategy when facing an unexpected obstacle?

questions.greatest-strength: What is your greatest strength according to those close to you?
questions.failure-reaction: How do you react after a painful failure on a project?
questions.unknown-place: You suddenly find yourself dropped in a completely unknown place, what do you do?

conflict.a: I raise my voice to immediately restore order and enforce my authority.
conflict.b: I act as a mediator to find a fair compromise for everyone.
conflict.c: I defuse the conflict using humor or a touch of irony.
conflict.d: I walk away; it is not my problem to solve.

ideal-space.a: An isolated, quiet place where nobody disturbs me.
ideal-space.b: A lively spot surrounded by people, music, and activity.
ideal-space.c: An ultra-organized, functional space where everything has its place.
ideal-space.d: A creative studio or workshop filled with ongoing projects.

ambiguous-task.a: I improvise on the spot based on my intuition.
ambiguous-task.b: I set up a rigorous strategic plan before laying the first brick.
ambiguous-task.c: I ask for the group's input so we can move forward together.
ambiguous-task.d: I handle it on my own, my way, without answering to anyone.

support.a: I take them under my wing and protect them at all costs.
support.b: I give them logical advice so they can solve the problem themselves.
support.c: It makes me uncomfortable; I prefer to keep my distance.
support.d: I use clever tricks or my contacts to solve their problem behind the scenes.

unexpected-obstacle.b: Find a creative workaround or a loophole in the system.
unexpected-obstacle.c: Coldly reassess the situation and adjust my approach.
unexpected-obstacle.d: Stand my ground and wait for the obstacle to give way.

social-event.a: I am the center of attention and the life of the party.
social-event.b: I stay with a few close friends to make sure everyone is doing well.
social-event.c: I prefer to observe from a quiet corner.
social-event.d: I like to throw out playful challenges or tease people.

daily-expression.a: Through art, style, music, or writing.
daily-expression.b: Through my achievements, my position, and my successes.
daily-expression.c: Through my sense of justice and fairness.
daily-expression.d: Through my humor, my stories, and my boldness.

greatest-strength.a: Your loyalty and your ability to care for others.
greatest-strength.c: Your boundless energy and limitless boldness.

failure-reaction.a: I slam my fist on the table and immediately jump back in to get my revenge.
failure-reaction.b: I dispassionately analyze my mistakes so I never repeat them.
failure-reaction.c: I bypass the issue or find a clever way to land on my feet.
failure-reaction.d: I seek comfort and advice from my close friends to process it.

unknown-place.a: I go explore the surroundings on my own without waiting for anyone.
unknown-place.b: I analyze the area and make a methodical mapping plan.
unknown-place.c: I immediately approach locals to make connections.
unknown-place.d: I go with the flow and trust my instincts of the moment.
